sentences.en: Oil on canvas can never paint a petal so delicate.
sentences.zh: 油画布永远无法描绘出如此细腻的花瓣。

sentences.en: His eyes got stuck on the canvas on the wall.
sentences.zh: 他的目光被墙上的画作吸引住了。

sentences.en: This durable oak deckchair comes with a floral canvas cover.
sentences.zh: 这款坚固的橡木躺椅配有花卉图案的帆布罩。
